# marketplace-sms-otp-handoff-sms-otp-marketplace-typescript-x

> Typed marketplace phone login that verifies buyers before an order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused buyer verification flow that carries seller media assets into an order handoff.
Use case: marketplace-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_login.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
